eligibility.plain_english: A loan is ineligible if any scheduled payment is more than 30 days past due at the cut-off date. Up to and including 30 days past due passes.
eligibility.clause_text: Delinquency. No scheduled payment on the Receivable is more than 30 days past due.

eligibility.plain_english: A loan that has been charged off, or whose vehicle has been repossessed, is ineligible.
eligibility.clause_text: Status. The Receivable has not been charged off and the related Financed Vehicle has not been repossessed.

eligibility.plain_english: The original term must be 84 months or less.
eligibility.clause_text: Term. The original term of the Receivable is 84 months or less.

eligibility.plain_english: The obligor's FICO score at origination must be 540 or higher.
eligibility.clause_text: Credit score. The Obligor's FICO score at origination is 540 or higher.

eligibility.plain_english: The outstanding balance must not exceed US$75,000.
eligibility.clause_text: Balance. The Outstanding Balance of the Receivable does not exceed US$75,000.

eligibility.plain_english: The obligor's billing address must be in one of the fifty US states or the District of Columbia. The tape has obligor_state, not a separate billing address field; obligor_state is used as the closest field.
eligibility.clause_text: Location. The Obligor's billing address is in one of the fifty states of the United States or the District of Columbia.

eligibility.plain_english: The obligor's billing address must not be in a Restricted Jurisdiction. The list of Restricted Jurisdictions is not in the material provided, so the test cannot be populated until that definition is obtained.
eligibility.clause_text: Restricted Jurisdictions. The Obligor's billing address is not in a Restricted Jurisdiction.

eligibility.plain_english: The loan may have been modified at most once since origination.
eligibility.clause_text: Modifications. The terms of the Receivable have been modified no more than once since origination.

eligibility.plain_english: The APR must be between 6.00% and 29.99%, both inclusive.
eligibility.clause_text: Annual percentage rate. The annual percentage rate of the Receivable is not less than 6.00% and not more than 29.99%.

eligibility.plain_english: The vehicle's model year must be no more than ten years before the year the loan was originated (compare model_year with the year of origination_date).
eligibility.clause_text: Vehicle age. The model year of the Financed Vehicle is no more than ten years before the year of origination of the Receivable.

eligibility.plain_english: The obligor must have made at least one scheduled payment.
eligibility.clause_text: Seasoning. The Obligor has made at least one scheduled payment on the Receivable.

eligibility.plain_english: The vehicle's VIN must not appear on any other loan in the pool; a repeated VIN suggests the car was pledged twice.
eligibility.clause_text: Unique collateral. The Financed Vehicle is identified by a Vehicle Identification Number that appears on no other Receivable in the Pool.

concentration.plain_english: Loans to obligors billed in any one state may make up at most 20% of the Eligible Pool Balance; any excess is an excess concentration.
concentration.clause_text: Obligors with a billing address in any one state

concentration.plain_english: Loans originated by any one dealer may make up at most 5% of the Eligible Pool Balance. Dealers under common ownership or trading under variations of one name count as one dealer.
concentration.clause_text: Receivables originated by any one Dealer, treating Dealers under common ownership or trading under variations of one name as one Dealer

concentration.plain_english: Loans with an original term of more than 72 months (strictly greater than 72) may make up at most 25% of the Eligible Pool Balance.
concentration.clause_text: Receivables with an original term of more than 72 months

concentration.plain_english: Loans secured by used vehicles may make up at most 70% of the Eligible Pool Balance.
concentration.clause_text: Receivables secured by used Financed Vehicles

concentration.plain_english: From 1 March 2026, loans whose obligor's FICO score at origination is below 600 (strictly less than 600) may make up at most 35% of the Eligible Pool Balance. Added by Amendment No. 1; it applies to Borrowing Base Certificates for Collection Periods ending on or after 1 March 2026, and the Amendment itself takes effect only once the conditions in its Section 3 are met.
concentration.clause_ref: Schedule 2, row 5 (added by Amendment No. 1, Section 2(b))
concentration.clause_text: Receivables with an Obligor FICO score at origination below 600
